reasoning: On the season so far the Bulls are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 5 points better, in a game of about 245 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (revenge, confidence).
Bottom line: the Bulls win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 220 and 268 total points.
